BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes the greatsacrifices that residents of this state may make through militaryservice. The legislature also recognizes that outofstate militaryservice might prevent a person from renewing a staterequired licensein a timely manner. Persons serving their country in the militaryshould not be penalized in this manner for such service. It is theintent of the legislature that persons who, because of military serviceoutside of this state, are unable to renew various licenses in a timelymanner, should be allowed to renew those licenses without incurringmonetary penalties that may ordinarily apply to the late renewal of alicense. It is the intent of the legislature that, under suchcircumstances, each state agency or entity, and each local governmententity, be directed to renew any staterequired licenses that areissued or may be issued by the state or local entity. It is not theintent of the legislature that any such renewal be allowed for a personwho is not at the time of the renewal fully qualified for the licensein question.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) To the extent that the department of licensing has authority toissue a license that must or may be renewed by the license holder, thedepartment of licensing shall issue a license renewal to a person whois a member of the armed forces, including the national guard and armedforces reserves, if the person was unable to renew his or her licensebecause of the person's assignment, reassignment, or deployment for HB 2249 p. 2 outofstate military service. Such a person may renew his or herlicense within ninety days after the person returns to this state fromoutofstate military service if the person's outofstate militaryservice was honorable, and if the person provides the following to theissuing authority no later than ninety days after the person's date ofdischarge or assignment, reassignment, or deployment back to thisstate: (a) A copy of the person's original order designating thespecific period of assignment, reassignment, or deployment for outofstate military service, and (b) if applicable, a copy of the person'sdischarge or amended or subsequent assignment, reassignment, ordeployment order back to this state. A license so renewed under thissection shall take effect on the expiration date of the prior license.A licensee renewing under this section shall pay only the applicablerenewal fee for the license and shall not be required to pay a penaltyor fee for late renewal. (2) For the purposes of this section, "license" means a franchise,permit, certification, approval, registration, charter, or similar formof authorization required by state law.

Such a person may renew his or her licensewithin ninety days after the person returns to this state from outofstate military service if the person's outofstate military servicewas honorable, and if the person provides the following to the issuingauthority no later than ninety days after the person's date ofdischarge or assignment, reassignment, or deployment back to thisstate: (a) A copy of the person's original order designating thespecific period of assignment, reassignment, or deployment for outofstate military service, and (b) if applicable, a copy of the person'sdischarge or amended or subsequent assignment, reassignment, ordeployment order back to this state. A license so renewed under thissection shall take effect on the expiration date of the prior license.A licensee renewing under this section shall pay only the applicable HB 2249 p. 16 renewal fee for the license and shall not be required to pay a penaltyor fee for late renewal. (2) For the purposes of this section, "license" means a franchise,permit, certification, approval, registration, charter, or similar formof authorization required by state law.

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) To the extent that the department has authority to issue alicense that must or may be renewed by the license holder, thedepartment shall issue a license renewal to a person who is a member ofthe armed forces, including the national guard and armed forcesreserves, if the person was unable to renew his or her license becauseof the person's assignment, reassignment, or deployment for outofstate military service. Such a person may renew his or her licensewithin ninety days after the person returns to this state from outofstate military service if the person's outofstate military servicewas honorable, and if the person provides the following to the issuingauthority no later than ninety days after the person's date ofdischarge or assignment, reassignment, or deployment back to thisstate: (a) A copy of the person's original order designating thespecific period of assignment, reassignment, or deployment for outofstate military service, and (b) if applicable, a copy of the person'sdischarge or amended or subsequent assignment, reassignment, ordeployment order back to this state. A license so renewed under thissection shall take effect on the expiration date of the prior license.A licensee renewing under this section shall pay only the applicablerenewal fee for the license and shall not be required to pay a penaltyor fee for late renewal. (2) For the purposes of this section, "license" means a franchise,permit, certification, approval, registration, charter, or similar formof authorization required by state law.
